mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (id, display_name, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{displayName}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO user_session (id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.display_name AS displayName, s.expires_at AS expiresAt FROM user_session s JOIN app_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.expires_at > #{now}
